formula: weighted mean of available normalized components; weights renormalized where the official forest-only raster has NoData

components.official_structural_2024: Generalitat Mapa bàsic de perill d'incendi forestal 2024, values 1-10 normalized to 0-1
components.surface_temperature: Landsat warm-season composite robust-scaled between study P10=22.82 C and P90=32.38 C
components.vegetation_dryness_ndmi: inverse Sentinel-2 NDMI robust-scaled between study P10=-0.039 and P90=0.251
components.territorial_concurrence: existing 0-1 score combining cover, habitat, slope, aspect, elevation and access similarity to historical fires

limitations: EcoRadar integrated structural reading; not the official daily danger, Pla Alfa, ignition probability or emergency alert.
Fuel-potential scores are explicit analytical assumptions by land-cover class and require field validation of fuel load and vertical structure.
Landsat temperature is a warm-season surface composite and NDMI is a relative spectral moisture proxy, not fine-fuel moisture.
